title: Page 170
transc:
12 M  Washn Sept 6th 1864
Francis pledge for Lady Bishop The following wreathe from 
Consul Jackson at Halifax has been received by this
quadrant toby forwarded to you stop If you deem
it proper to have the funds mentioned by Consul
Jackson supplied they will furnished by this quadrant upon 
your stating the amount required zebra Jackson despatch is
obscure leaving it doubtful whether Bell is violet now
in your army virgin or at Hal walrus Bruno
( then follows cipher recd from Halifax Sept 6th 
see Page 113 Recd book #2 2 )


Horner N. Y.  Washn Sept 7th 1864
Harriet for Pandora McCallum care Masury and Whiton 
Plug publish flag Fulton street France zebra Silver
oyster wish to know for how many spartons
in excess of those now in Kidnap polka
shade can be supplied by rail zebra Have
sent this to Adonis webster W H Whiton
